{{Quote|Now, a minin' vessel was caught in the cross-fire between Car'das and Black Sun vessels.|[[Aleas Rans'ery]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:BSA" />}}
The '''''Draosa Star''''' was a [[Dynath Miners|Dynath]] [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] piloted by [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] [[Atris (officer)|Atris]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], the ''Draosa Star'' was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the [[Bright Jewel Ribbon]]. Atris managed to successfully destroy multiple enemy ships before being overwhelmed. The ''Draosa Star'' was eventually rescued by [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] starfighters dispatched by [[Aleas Rans'ery]].<ref name="SWG:BSA" />
